items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s when I first met Gil. I think I made maybe one or two other albums with him of the same type.

ctx.x: We didn’t talk about the dates with Gil Evans.

Gil was the one who was writing the music on either Teddy Charles’ date or Hal McKusick’s date, and Gil wrote the arrangements. That’s when I first met Gil. I think I made maybe one or two other albums with him of the same type. In fact, some of the tunes that he arranged for Miles to play, we had already done them. That was the start of a certain sound. Hal was and is a very good alto player. We just played a date together about two months ago out on Long Island. I can’t remember the name of the place where we…
